source.authors: Tiunov MP, Liu S, Feng J, Soisook P, Jiang T
source.title: A new species of Myotis from China with notes on the siligorensis species group (Chiroptera, Vespertilionidae)

where: Diagnosis. paragraph (heading 'Diagnosis.'), sentence 'The measurements of the holotype (in mm) were as follows'
quote: The measurements of the holotype (in mm) were as follows: body length – 35, tail length – 28, length of the free tail tip – 0.5, ear length – 11.9, tragus length – 5.5, […]
method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the Diagnosis prose; Methods: external measurements taken to the nearest 0.1 mm with a dial caliper; Methods state three specimens of the species were fixed in 75% ethanol (where external measurements were taken is not stated)
conditions: Adult male holotype IBSS CQ-08c-16 ('adult male, body in 75% alcohol, skull and baculum extracted'). The paper prints no paratype or female ear or tragus values for the species. The paper has no external-measurement table (Tables 1-3 are samples, PCA loadings and distances); values only in this Diagnosis sentence. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
note: Quote is the sentence start through the ear length value; the sentence continues with further measurements (cut marked […]), none a qualifier of this value. Methods list 'E' as ear length and 'Tr' as tragus length (page tool output, no further definition of landmarks). Sentence reassembled from two consecutive pieces returned by the page tool. Name: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1006997 lists Myotis kalkoae, Vespertilionidae, holotype IBSS CQ-08c-16, no synonyms, 'recently described'. Not on main (grep of docs/ for species, DOI and id). Page-printed licence sentence reported by the page tool from the exact copy opened: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0),' The licence line was reported for the ZooKeys XML copy and the article_preview copy; the sentence itself was seen in the fetch of the XML copy. Licence checked by audit 462: full sentence on the article_preview page ('This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.') and Crossref list query: license http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, content-version vor, start 2025-11-07. Crossref and page print the fifth author as Tinglei Jiang (initial T).

source.authors: Luo T, Mao M-L, Lan C-T, Zhao Z-F, Wang Z-L, Yu J, Wang J-J, Yan C-R, Xiao N, Zhou J
source.title: Four new tube-nosed bat species of the genus Murina (Chiroptera, Vespertilionidae) from Xizang Autonomous Region, China, based on morphological and molecular data

measurement: ear length of the holotype (EL: lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna)
method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods: ear length 'from lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna', recorded to the nearest 0.1 mm using digital calipers; specimens fixed in 95% ethanol
conditions: Adult male holotype (field number XZ2023010), body mass 3.36 g. Values printed to 0.01 mm although Methods state calipers read to the nearest 0.1 mm. Type series (Description and Table 4): EL 12.48-14.58 mm; Table 4 males 12.48-14.58 (13.46 ± 0.82, n = 6), females 13.12-13.95 (13.55 ± 0.34, n = 4); the holotype lies at the low end. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Murina milinensis sp. nov. account, line under the heading 'Measurements (in mm) and body weight (in g) of the holotype.'
note: Quote is the first part of a longer measurement line (cut marked; the rest lists tibia, skull values and BW: 3.36); 'holotype' and units are in the heading. Holotype paragraph: 'Adult male, field number XZ2023010'. EL definition and Methods instrument and fixation re-read by audit 462 in the publisher's JATS XML of this paper. Same paper as desk-d345 M. medogensis (different species). Name: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1006945 lists Murina milinensis, Vespertilionidae, holotype XZ2023010, no synonyms, 'recently described'. Not on main (grep of docs/ for the binomial and article id). Licence: full CC BY 4.0 sentence on the page and in the JATS XML; Crossref list query (audit 462): license http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, content-version vor, start 2025-06-02.

source.authors: Zhang T, Yang S, Jiang H, Gu L, Zou Q, Fu C, Guo K, Zhang T, Liu S, Chen S
source.title: A new species of the genus Soriculus (Soricidae, Eulipotyphla, Mammalia) from Medog, Tibet, China, based on morphological and molecular data

method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods: external measurements (W, HBL, TL, HL, EL) were taken in the field (fresh specimens); no landmark or instrument stated for them (the 0.01 mm digital caliper applies to craniodental metrics)
conditions: Adult male holotype SAF11216 (collected 29 October 2011), weight 12.1 g, head-body 80 mm. EL printed as a whole millimetre. Table 1 (new species listed as 'Soriculus sp.', N = 11): EL 7 ± 0, range 7, so all specimens read 7 mm at this precision. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Soriculus dexingensis sp. nov., paragraph headed 'Measurements of holotype (mm).'
note: Quote is the start of a one-paragraph measurement list (cut marked; rest are skull dimensions); the paragraph was returned by the page tool in two consecutive pieces and the start is verbatim from piece 1. 'adult male' comes from the Holotype section, not the measurement paragraph. Name: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1007001 lists Soriculus dexingensis (Soricidae), holotype SAF 11216, citation ZooKeys 1262:175-189, no synonyms. Not on main (grep of docs/).
